abstract: In 62 patients with testicular germinative tumours and 301 healthy unrelated subjects, 23 HLA antigens of A and B loci were tested. In the group of 40 seminomas the incidence of HLA-Bw35 antigen and in 22 patients with non-seminomas (embryonal carcinomas, teratocarcinoma and mixed forms) the frequency of HLA-A 10 antigen were significantly higher (27.50 vs. 14.28% in the controls, p greater than 0.025; 36.36 vs. 15.28%, p less than 0.025). After correction by multiplying p by the number of typed antigens there was no statistically significant result any more. The causes of dubious results of the studies about the association between HLA and malignancies are discussed.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者62例と健常な非血縁者301例について、A、B遺伝子座のHLA抗原23種を検査した。セミノーマ40例ではHLA-Bw35抗原の頻度が、非セミノーマ22例（胎児性癌、奇形癌および混合型を含む）ではHLA-A10抗原の頻度が、対照群と比較して有意に高かった。検定した抗原数で補正すると、もはや統計学的に有意な結果は得られなかった。HLAと悪性腫瘍との関連に関する研究で結果が疑わしい原因について考察する。
